'''Visrak Ortano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Overseer]] on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to destroy a bomb constructed by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], despite the protests of [[Karish-Ma]], who wanted to study it.
